title: Enriques surfaces and nonexistence over the integers
summary: This roadmap develops geometric Enriques surfaces over arbitrary fields and flat proper algebraic-space families, their canonical degree-two covers, characteristic-two types and numerical lattices. It combines Picard descent, dyadic twisting, finite-field genus-one fibrations and lattice configuration arguments to plan integral and F₂ nonexistence. The endpoints retain explicit completeness, omitted-configuration and source-acquisition gates rather than claiming that these gaps are proved.
readme: The reader document specifies nine layers, their target-level statements, hypotheses, proofs, definition APIs and discriminating tests. Imports retain the current upstream IntegralLattices, JacobianChallenge, AlgebraicVectorBundles and LocalFieldsRamification contracts. Generic Picard/descent, genus-one classification, K3 and Fontaine inputs are separate proposed suppliers. Both final endpoints require classification completeness and the three omitted Enriques configuration exclusions.

stages.title: Geometric Enriques surfaces and their lattice
stages.description: Define the shared geometric condition over arbitrary fields, prove Picard and cohomological invariants and identify the even unimodular numerical lattice using IntegralLattices Layer 6A.

stages.title: Half-fibres, canonical covers and exceptionality
stages.description: Develop half-fibres and integral two-sections, the three characteristic-two types, canonical local torsors, the conductrix and exceptional-fibration restrictions. Establish the general partner theorem and canonical-type-to-fibration correspondence.

stages.title: Families, Picard descent and canonical torsors
stages.description: Use flat proper finitely presented algebraic spaces. Construct their relative Picard and numerical objects, canonical-cover obstruction and twisting, constant/split distinctions, and descent of curves and fibrations under the cohomological Brauer hypothesis.

stages.title: Integral Picard constancy through dyadic twists
stages.description: First prove numerical constancy and Num-only point counts. Obtain local sections and projective scheme models, compare canonical covers over Q₂, remove the ramified difference with one of four global twists and apply the imported Fontaine obstruction. Split the remaining étale extension.

stages.title: Finite-field Jacobians and descended sections
stages.description: Apply the generic Jacobian model and local genus-one comparison. Repair smooth-point and Tsen arguments, obtain constant Jacobian Picard and matching fibre point counts. Import the rational-Jacobian classification with its completeness gate.

stages.title: Candidate configurations and their first reductions
stages.description: Keep fourteen elliptic candidates and four quasielliptic ones. Exclude the three omitted elliptic cases as a separate proof obligation; establish multiplicity and partner restrictions, then the I₈, II*, IV*, IV and multiple-I₄* reductions on their precise domains.

stages.title: Ten-curve lattices and the I₄* exclusion
stages.description: Specify both ten-curve graphs and revised integral Gram matrices. Use built discriminant forms and even overlattices, generic degree-zero Picard quotients, descended integral two-sections of square 0 or −2, and exhaustive incidence orbits to exclude I₄*.

stages.title: III* exclusions and restricted fibrations
stages.description: Treat multiple and simple III* separately, with the four simple incidence cases. Prove the two-configuration impossibility over any algebraically closed field, importing the characteristic-independent partner theorem.

stages.title: Lifting and the two nonexistence endpoints
stages.description: Establish the characteristic-two lifting/deformation contracts, rule out exceptional modulo-four fibres, and assemble the F₂ and integral endpoints only after classification completeness and the omitted-configuration exclusions.
